lines: Things run double — being, unbeing, the two-yoked course.
Leap it. To the Third — bow to wondrous Śambhu.
sanskrit_cite: sadasattvena bhāvānāṃ yuktā yā dvitayī gatiḥ | tām ullaṅghya tṛtīyasmai namaś citrāya śambhave

lines: Gods, seers, men — this triple world unfree.
But free are they who live off Thee alone, O Free — Thy hangers-on.
sanskrit_cite: āsurarṣijanād asminn asvatantre jagattraye | svatantrās te svatantrasya ye tavaivānujīvinaḥ

lines: Thy body, gem-set with the whole world —
remembering it: the one medicine for existence-pain. Who hold it, sit easy.
sanskrit_cite: aśeṣaviśvakhacitabhavadvapur anusmṛtiḥ | yeṣām bhavarujām ekaṃ bheṣajaṃ te sukhāsinaḥ

lines: Whose white parasol is the moon, lit with its own light;
whose whisk is heaven-river's rush — He alone is high Lord.
sanskrit_cite: sitātapatraṃ yasyenduḥ svaprabhāparipūritaḥ | cāmaraṃ svardhunīsrotaḥ sa ekaḥ parameśvaraḥ

lines: Bright, cool, single, pure — like a moon-sliver —
deal me a glance, Lord, any at all, nectar-flowing.
sanskrit_cite: prakāśāṃ śītalām ekāṃ śuddhāṃ śaśikalām iva | dṛśaṃ vitara me nātha kām apy amṛtavāhinīm

lines: Drops fallen from Thy knowing-bliss sea — these knowings —
why, Lord, in my mouth not nectar-sweet, not lovely?
sanskrit_cite: tvaccidānandajaladheś cyutāḥ saṃvittivipruṣaḥ | imāḥ kathaṃ me bhagavan nāmṛtāsvādasundarāḥ

lines: Hearts undipped in Thy love-sap, Lord —
whose are so, Master, are heartless, nothing else: such are contempt's seat.
sanskrit_cite: tvayi rāgarase nātha na magnaṃ hṛdayaṃ prabho | yeṣām ahṛdayā eva te 'vajñaspadam īdṛśāḥ

lines: Whose heart has met with Thine, Lord —
he, he alone, holds the ruling Ladies' powers: their one high vessel.
sanskrit_cite: prabhuṇā bhavatā yasya jātaṃ hṛdayamelanam | prābhavīṇāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ paramekaḥ sa bhājanam

lines: Drowner of joys, then sorrows — all, alike —
Thy thought-nectar in flood, over low ground, as water seeks it.
sanskrit_cite: harṣāṇām atha śokānāṃ sarveṣāṃ plāvakaḥ samam | bhavaddhyānāmṛtāpūro nimnāṇimnabhuvām iva

lines: What would their eyes not hold, brimmed with joy-stores —
they who, by more than life, Lord, nowhere ever leave Thee?
sanskrit_cite: keva na syād dṛśā teṣāṃ sukhasambhāranirbharā | yeṣām ātmādhikeneśa na kvāpi virahas tvayā

lines: I thunder — ah! — I dance: my mind-chariots ride full, for my Master is won —
since Thou, Thou utterly delightest.
sanskrit_cite: garjāmi bata nṛtyāmi pūrṇā mama manorathāḥ | svāmī mamaiṣa ghaṭito yat tvam atyantarocanaḥ

lines: No other known for doing, no other yoke for knowing —
and yet, what of knowing? Thou — all-one-full Knowing — unfoldest.
sanskrit_cite: nānyad vedyaṃ kriyā yatra nānyo yogo vidā ca yat | jñānaṃ syāt kiṃ tu viśvaikapūrṇā cittvaṃ vijṛmbhate

lines: Hard, endless pains — suddenly out of their grip, fled —
from whom? Those in whose speech rings ever the Śiva-din.
sanskrit_cite: durjayānām anantānām duḥkhānāṃ sahasaiva te | hastāt palāyitā yeṣāṃ vāci śaśvacchivadhvaniḥ

lines: Is there another high One, marked by remaining Thine?
Thou alone art the great Person — shelter of persons, none left out.
sanskrit_cite: uttamaḥ puruṣo 'nyo 'sti yuṣmaccheṣaviśeṣitaḥ | tvaṃ mahāpuruṣas tv eko niḥśeṣapuruṣāśrayaḥ

lines: They win — Thy slaves, honored by the world, O world-pervader —
for whom this very passing-sea is a play-lake.
sanskrit_cite: jayanti te jagadvandyā dāsās te jagatāṃ vibho | saṃsārārṇava evaiṣa yeṣāṃ krīḍāmahāsaraḥ

lines: Let other miseries sit a while —
here, for Thy partakers, appear plain, Thou — by that alone they are shamed.
sanskrit_cite: āsatāṃ tāvad anyāni dainyānīha bhavajjuṣām | tvam eva prakaṭībhūyā ity anenaiva lajjyate

lines: 'Naught beyond me' — yet even there I tell my beads, one with that.
In truth: 'murmur on' — with bead-strand Thou pointest onward.
sanskrit_cite: matparaṃ nāsti tatrāpi jāpako 'smi tadaikyataḥ | tattvena japa ity akṣamālayā diśasi kvacit

lines: From being, needs must, highest being — and being past even that, Lord. And Thou —
other than being, other than unbeing — so art Thou being-unbeing-stuff.
sanskrit_cite: sato 'vaśyaṃ paramasat sac ca tasmāt paraṃ prabho | tvaṃ cāsataḥ sataś cānyas tenāsi sadasanmayaḥ

lines: Purer-bright than a thousand suns raying up —
yet Thou, though through all worlds spread, art not seen.
sanskrit_cite: sahasrasūryakiraṇādhikaśuddhaprakāśavān | api tvaṃ sarvabhuvanavyāpako 'pi na dṛśyase

lines: Knowing-shaped in the dead world, they say —
knower inside the known; mighty in the measured: since Thou art so — highest of all, Lord.
sanskrit_cite: jaḍe jagati cidrūpaḥ kila vedye 'pi vedakaḥ | vibhur mite ca yenāsi tena sarvottamo bhavān

lines: Enough of other wailings — just this, before the Lord: I keen aloud —
for, Lord, I swoon, knowing even so.
sanskrit_cite: alam ākranditair anyair iyad eva puraḥ prabhoḥ | tīvraṃ viraumi yan nātha muhyāmy evaṃ vidann api
